product_one_liner.value: Kojo is a materials procurement and inventory-management platform that helps trade and self-performing general contractors manage purchasing and materials from takeoff through project closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: Kojo describes the platform and its contractor users directly.

pricing_page.notes: Kojo has a public pricing page that offers custom quotes.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in Kojo customer-story materials.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 163 employees, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: Kojo’s company profile lists its headquarters in San Francisco, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: Kojo Engineering states that Kojo was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering publication shows one technical post, about rebranding and technical debt, and says its last publication was in October 2022; it does not meet the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Kojo has a public API documentation site and a help center with multiple release-note articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open listings are a Demand Gen Lead and a Revenue Operations Support Analyst; neither is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.value: OpenAI's GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Kojo publicly names both in its description of the Kojo Intelligence Layer.

compliance_certs.notes: Kojo says it successfully completed a SOC 2 audit.

last_funding.notes: Kojo announced a Series C extension in October 2025; the report identifies the amount as $10 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 2025 Series C extension occurred within the 18-month period before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The two open roles are Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst, not SDR, BDR, or account executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog describes a new multi-warehouse feature, but the available evidence does not show the post date; therefore its launch cannot be placed inside or outside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A profile lists Micah Rodman as Kojo Co-Founder & CEO starting January 2026, within the 12 months before the cutoff.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Kojo job posting explicitly says the Sales and Customer Success teams run on Salesforce.
